label: WRONG
reason: Handlers take Depends(get_db) (not a wrapper, hence clear:false) because they query the database (account.py, api_keys.py, email_preferences.py); the outliers in feedback.py and media.py never touch the DB (Discord webhook, config/file listings), and tasks.py get_task_progress_sse deliberately opens a short AsyncSessionLocal so a long SSE stream does not hold a session. New DB-free endpoints would be flagged for nothing.

label: WRONG
reason: Not linted (eslint.config.mjs only extends next/core-web-vitals and next/typescript, no react/no-danger). Two of three outliers emit JSON-LD <script> blocks via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with JSON.stringify and '<' escaping, a recurring SEO pattern also used across app pages, so new structured-data components would get false alarms; only home-app.tsx's style innerHTML interpolating font names is worth a look. Hesitated with ACCEPT since raw HTML is an XSS surface a reviewer might want to confirm.

label: WRONG
reason: '<next>' apparently means a next/* component such as Link/Image (as in [slug]/page.tsx, terms/page.tsx, status/page.tsx), which the wording does not say. The only outlier, app/page.tsx HomePage, renders HomeRouter, which renders LandingPage that renders next/link Link and next/image Image, so it complies through a helper; the rule is also largely incidental to pages having links.
